==Summary==

:{{pov|[[Ladalin]]}}
The fourth vision is seen through the eyes of [[Ladalin]] who is an [[Aiel]] [[Wise One]] descended from the dragon. During a meeting with the other Wise Ones and [[Clan chief]]s they learn the [[White Tower]] has fallen. [[Jorshem]] states that the war with the Ravens has been lost. Ladalin tells the others that to surrender would be the end of the Aiel as they would be made ''[[gai'shain]]''. They decide to retreat back to the [[Three-Fold Land]].

:{{pov|[[Aviendha]]}}
Aviendha is appalled at the lack of honor the Aiel of the future display. She carries on walking.

:{{pov|[[Oncala]]}}
The fifth vision is seen through the eyes of [[Oncala]] who is Aviendha's granddaughter. Oncala and [[Hehyal]], clan chief of the [[Taardad]] Aiel, meet with Queen [[Talana]] who is [[Elayne Trakand]]'s granddaughter. The Aiel show plans for an attack on Andor which they stole from the Ebou Dari palace. They didn't tell her that it was only going to be used if Andor entered the war. (Their deception to bring Andor into their own fight with the Seanchan leads to the Seanchan gaining the dragons and thus Lightsticks.)

:{{pov|[[Aviendha]]}}
Aviendha is disgusted with Oncala, and her hereditary tie to herself. She takes another step.

:{{pov|[[Padra]]}}
The final vision is of Aviendha's daughter [[Padra]] who attacks a group of Seanchan who wondered into their borders after the peace has been signed between ''wetlander'' nations and the Seanchan, (but not the Aiel). Padra and her siblings [[Alarch]], [[Janduin (son)|Janduin]] and [[Marinna]] are part of a war committee with the Clan chiefs and Wise Ones. They decide that because the Seanchan hadn't released their Wise Ones and the Aiel aren't part of the [[Dragon's Peace]], the Aiel are going to march to war against the Seanchan. This future also confirms one of Min's visions about Aviendha indeed having quadruplets to Rand. 

The strange thing about them mentioned by Min is (possibly) that they could channel since childhood and perpetually embrace the True Source. Though Padra is young, Aviendha is not present in this vision that can be interpreted in three ways: she is dead, she is gone to follow Rand or, simply, vision cannot show the seer itself. Each of the quadruplets looks different, Alarch has dark hair, Janduin blond, and Marinna is small of build with a round face.

:{{pov|[[Aviendha]]}}
Stepping out of the pillars, Aviendha resolves to do all she can to prevent this future from coming to pass and leaves Rhuidean to rejoin with her people.
